SessionStart._comment: startup and resume ONLY. SessionStart also fires on 'compact', 'clear' and 'fork' — all of which happen mid-conversation on the SAME machine, where there is nothing to restore. Pulling then is at best wasted work and at worst writes over files the running session is using.

SessionEnd._comment: Hooks fire PER CONVERSATION, not per client. Several conversations ending together means several concurrent pushes at one remote, so cli.mjs takes a lock and later arrivals no-op rather than race. 'clear' is excluded: clearing context is not finishing work, and it would push on every /clear.
